summary: Several studies have directly applied graph neural networks to predict customer attrition. The most effective approach, as reported by Adebayo et al. (2026) [V0193], uses message passing over relational graphs and achieves an AUROC of 0.91 on the ChurnBench dataset. Brennan et al. (2018) [V0194] also employed message passing over relational graphs, achieving an F1 score of 0.63 on MetroFlow. Chen et al. (2019) [V0195] revisited the problem and reported an accuracy of 0.7 on Atlas-ICU. Duarte et al. (2020) [V0196] applied a similar approach and obtained an MAE of 0.77 on AgriSat-4. El-Sayed et al. (2021) [V0209] used multilevel probabilistic models with partial pooling, achieving an AUROC of 0.65 on ChurnBench.
